title: Custom Creations
intro: For projects that aren't already on the shelf — keepsakes, one-offs, and ideas that need a little conversation first.

blocks.html: There are no custom inquiry submissions here yet — the full request form is coming after launch. Until then, email is the best way to start.
When you reach out, share your name, email, project type, rough budget and timeline, preferred size and materials, and a short description. Inspiration photos help a lot.
Custom work is made by hand in small batches of one — timing depends on the season and how detailed the piece is.
Send a note to skylar@wildhouselane.com, or use the contact page. We'll reply with next steps.
